seller.description: Snyk provides an AI-native, agentic security platform that helps organizations secure and govern software development. It validates AI-generated code, the models and agents used in development, and the applications built by them through deterministic security engines combined with frontier-model reasoning. The platform includes Evo Agent Security, Agentic Development Security (ADS), AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM), and Continuous Offensive Security (COS), covering asset discovery, AI guardrails, risk prioritization, AI-accelerated remediation, governance/measurement, and agentic orchestration.
